# Each file below starts with its own FILE line (five = signs, FILE:, its path). Generated by tools/build-previews.py.

===== FILE: .env.example =====
# Copy this file to .env and fill in ACCESS_TOKEN.
# Tagembed dashboard -> your gallery's card -> three-dot menu -> "Access Token".
ACCESS_TOKEN=
# Always this value - nothing to copy from the dashboard.
API_BASE_URL=https://api.tagembed.com/api
# Theme file name from the themes/ folder, e.g. modern-card, vivid, review-list.
WIDGET_THEME=modern-card

===== FILE: .htaccess =====
# Keep the token and the cache private on Apache hosts (cPanel and the like).
<FilesMatch "^\.env">
  Require all denied
</FilesMatch>
RedirectMatch 404 ^/?(.*/)?cache/

===== FILE: README.md =====
# Social Widget - Simple HTML

Shows the live posts from your Tagembed gallery, in the theme you picked. Until you add your token it shows sample posts, so you can run it right away.

## Files

| File | What it does |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | The page: loads the theme and posts from `posts.php` and draws the cards. No framework, no build step. |
| `posts.php` | The only server file and the only place the token lives: calls Tagembed with the cache, returns JSON. |
| `.htaccess` | Keeps `.env` and `cache/` private on Apache hosts. |
| `themes/` | All 19 themes (`.css` is the look, `.json` is how a card is laid out). |
| `samples/` | The sample posts shown while `ACCESS_TOKEN` is empty. |
| `.env.example` | The settings - copy it to `.env`. |

Keep `preview.html` (from the chat) next to it as the design reference - it opens by double-click and needs nothing.

## Run it

This runs on any PHP host (cPanel and the like). For a host without PHP, pick the Node.js stack instead.

**On a host:** upload the whole folder (with `.env`) to your site, for example into `public_html/social-widget/`, and open that address. On nginx, block `.env` and `cache/` in the server config - `.htaccess` only works on Apache.

**On your computer**

1. Install PHP 8 once: macOS `brew install php`, Windows https://windows.php.net/download, Ubuntu `sudo apt install php-cli php-curl`.
2. Open a terminal in this folder (macOS: right-click the folder, **New Terminal at Folder**; Windows: open the folder, type `cmd` in the address bar, press Enter).
3. Type `php -S localhost:8080` and press Enter, then open http://localhost:8080.

Double-clicking `index.html` does not work - it needs `posts.php` running. `preview.html` is the one that opens by double-click.

## Settings

Copy `.env.example` to a new file named `.env` in the same folder and fill it in:

| Setting | What to put |
|---|---|
| `ACCESS_TOKEN` | Your gallery's token: Tagembed dashboard, the gallery's card, three-dot menu, **Access Token**. Leave it empty to see the sample posts. |
| `API_BASE_URL` | Always `https://api.tagembed.com/api` - nothing to copy. |
| `WIDGET_THEME` | The theme, by file name in `themes/`: `classic-card`, `social-card`, `modern-card`, `classic-photo`, `square-photo`, `collage`, `vivid`, `horizontal-slider`, `horizontal-columns`, `slider`, `reels`, `story-theme`, `single-post`, `widget-theme`, `review-box`, `review-carousel`, `review-list`, `rating-badge`, `badge`. |

The token stays on the server. It never appears in the page, in View Source or in the browser.

## Changing the look

- Another theme: change `WIDGET_THEME` in `.env`, then nothing - PHP reads `.env` on every visit.
- Your own colours, font, columns: create `custom.css` next to `posts.php` with your changes. It is added after the theme, so it wins. For example:

  ```css
  :root { --tbd-bg: #fff8f0; --tbd-cols: 4; --tbd-radius: 16px; }
  ```

  The variables are listed at the top of your theme's file in `themes/`.

## How the cache works

Posts are saved in `cache/posts.json` for 5 minutes (`CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` in `posts.php`), so Tagembed is called about 288 times a day however many people visit. When the saved copy runs out, one request refreshes it and everyone else keeps getting the saved copy. If Tagembed cannot be reached, the last good copy keeps showing - a stale widget beats an empty one. If the `cache` folder cannot be written, the widget still works; it just calls Tagembed on every visit (the log says so).

## If it goes wrong

- **The "Sample posts" note stays on the page** - `ACCESS_TOKEN` is empty, or the file is not named exactly `.env`, or it is not in this folder. After editing it: nothing - PHP reads `.env` on every visit.
- **"No posts to show yet"** - the log says why: `Tagembed API 401: ...` means a wrong token or the daily limit; no error means the gallery has no approved posts yet.
- **Wrong look** - check the spelling of `WIDGET_THEME`. An unknown name falls back to `modern-card` and says so in the log.

===== FILE: index.html =====
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Social Widget</title>
<!-- Theme CSS: posts.php serves themes/<WIDGET_THEME>.css + custom.css -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="posts.php?css=1">
</head>
<body>
<!-- Social Widget - Simple HTML starter. No framework, no build step.
     The token lives only in posts.php (View Source here shows none). -->
<section class="tbd-widget" id="social-widget">
  <h1 class="tbd-header">Social Widget</h1>
  <p class="tbd-empty">Loading posts…</p>
</section>
<script>
(function () {
  // Same card markup as preview.html. Every value is escaped before it is
  // written; links and images are limited to http(s).
  const NET_MARK = {
    instagram: 'IG', facebook: 'f', twitter: 'X', x: 'X', tiktok: '♪', youtube: '▶', linkedin: 'in',
    pinterest: 'P', google: 'G', yelp: 'y', tripadvisor: 'T', trustpilot: '★',
  };
  
  function esc(value) {
    return String(value == null ? '' : value)
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#x27;');
  }
  
  // Only http(s) links and images - never javascript: or data: from the API.
  function safeUrl(url) {
    return typeof url === 'string' && /^https?:\/\//i.test(url) ? url : '';
  }
  
  function shortDate(iso) {
    const d = new Date(iso);
    if (isNaN(d)) return '';
    return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' });
  }
  
  // Photo-only themes skip posts without an image - they would be empty cards.
  function visiblePosts(posts, parts) {
    if (parts.join() !== 'media') return posts;
    return posts.filter((p) => Array.isArray(p.media) && p.media.some((m) => m && m.type === 'image' && safeUrl(m.cdn_url)));
  }
  
  function renderCard(post, parts) {
    const author = post.author || {};
    const network = post.network || {};
    const name = author.name || author.handle || '';
    const netName = network.name || '';
    const media = Array.isArray(post.media) ? post.media : [];
    // The first media entry of type "image" - never media[0], which can be a video.
    const image = parts.includes('media') ? media.find((m) => m && m.type === 'image' && safeUrl(m.cdn_url)) : null;
    const blocks = {};
  
    if (image) {
      let style = image.width && image.height ? `--tbd-ar:${Number(image.width)} / ${Number(image.height)};` : '';
      if (typeof image.preview_data_uri === 'string' && image.preview_data_uri.startsWith('data:image/')) {
        style += `--tbd-ph:url(${image.preview_data_uri})`;
      }
      const play = media.some((m) => m && m.type === 'video') ? '<span class="tbd-play"></span>' : '';
      blocks.media = `<div class="tbd-media" data-network="${esc(netName)}"${style ? ` style="${esc(style)}"` : ''}>`
        + `<img src="${esc(image.cdn_url)}" alt="" loading="lazy">${play}</div>`;
    }
  
    const initial = esc(name.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase());
    const avatar = safeUrl(author.avatar_url)
      ? `<img class="tbd-avatar" src="${esc(author.avatar_url)}" alt="" loading="lazy" data-initial="${initial}">`
      : `<span class="tbd-avatar">${initial}</span>`;
    const slug = String(network.slug || '').toLowerCase();
    blocks.head = `<div class="tbd-head">${avatar}<div class="tbd-who">`
      + (name ? `<span class="tbd-author">${esc(name)}</span>` : '')
      + `<time class="tbd-date" datetime="${esc(post.created_at)}">${esc(shortDate(post.created_at))}</time></div>`
      + `<span class="tbd-net" data-net="${esc(slug)}" data-mark="${esc(NET_MARK[slug] || netName.slice(0, 1))}" title="${esc(netName)}"></span></div>`;
  
    const rating = Number(post.rating);
    if (rating >= 1 && rating <= 5) {
      const r = Math.round(rating);
      blocks.stars = `<div class="tbd-stars" aria-label="${r} out of 5">${'★'.repeat(r)}${'☆'.repeat(5 - r)}</div>`;
    }
    const text = post.content && post.content.text;
    if (text) blocks.text = `<p class="tbd-text">${esc(text)}</p>`;
  
    const inner = parts.filter((p) => blocks[p]).map((p) => blocks[p]).join('\n      ');
    const cls = image || !parts.includes('media') ? 'tbd-card' : 'tbd-card tbd-card--text';
    const href = safeUrl(post.source && post.source.permalink) || '#';
    return `    <a class="${cls}" href="${esc(href)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">\n      ${inner}\n    </a>`;
  }
  
  // Rating Badge / Badge: the average of every rated post, its stars and the count.
  function renderBadge(posts) {
    const rated = posts.filter((p) => typeof p.rating === 'number' && p.rating >= 1 && p.rating <= 5);
    const nets = [];
    rated.forEach((p) => {
      const n = p.network || {};
      if (n.slug && !nets.some((x) => x.slug === n.slug)) nets.push({ slug: n.slug, name: n.name || '' });
    });
    const avg = rated.length ? rated.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.rating, 0) / rated.length : 0;
    const title = nets.length === 1 ? `${nets[0].name} Reviews` : 'Customer Reviews';
    const full = Math.floor(avg + 0.5);
    const marks = nets.map((n) => `<span class="tbd-net" data-net="${esc(n.slug)}" data-mark="${esc(NET_MARK[n.slug] || n.name.slice(0, 1))}" `
      + `title="${esc(n.name)}"></span>`).join('');
    return '  <div class="tbd-badge">\n'
      + `    <div class="tbd-badge-nets">${marks}</div>\n`
      + `    <div class="tbd-badge-title">${esc(title)}</div>\n`
      + `    <div class="tbd-badge-score"><span class="tbd-badge-avg">${avg.toFixed(1)}</span>`
      + `<span class="tbd-stars" aria-label="${avg.toFixed(1)} out of 5">${'★'.repeat(full)}${'☆'.repeat(5 - full)}</span></div>\n`
      + `    <div class="tbd-badge-count">Based on ${rated.length} review${rated.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</div>\n`
      + '  </div>';
  }

  var root = document.getElementById('social-widget');

  function show(data) {
    var meta = data.theme;
    var posts = visiblePosts(data.posts || [], meta.parts);
    root.className = 'tbd-widget tbd-t-' + meta.slug + ' tbd-l-' + meta.layout + (meta.clamp ? ' tbd-clamp' : '');
    var note = data.sample ? '<p class="tbd-note">Sample posts - set ACCESS_TOKEN in .env to show your gallery.</p>' : '';
    var track = posts.length
      ? '<div class="tbd-track">' + posts.map(function (p) { return renderCard(p, meta.parts); }).join('\n') + '</div>'
      : '<p class="tbd-empty">No posts to show yet.</p>';
    if (meta.layout === 'badge' && posts.length) track = renderBadge(posts);
    if (meta.layout === 'slider' && posts.length) {
      track = '<div class="tbd-slider"><button class="tbd-arrow tbd-arrow--prev" type="button" data-dir="-1" aria-label="Previous">‹</button>'
        + track + '<button class="tbd-arrow tbd-arrow--next" type="button" data-dir="1" aria-label="Next">›</button></div>';
    }
    root.innerHTML = '<h1 class="tbd-header">Social Widget</h1>' + note + track;
    // Arrows scroll the row by one view.
    root.querySelectorAll('.tbd-arrow').forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener('click', function () {
        var t = b.parentNode.querySelector('.tbd-track');
        t.scrollBy({ left: b.dataset.dir * t.clientWidth, behavior: 'smooth' });
      });
    });
  }

  fetch('posts.php')
    .then(function (r) { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(show)
    .catch(function () {
      root.querySelector('.tbd-empty').textContent =
        'Could not load posts. Open this page through a PHP server (see README) - preview.html shows the design without one.';
    });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

===== FILE: posts-tail.php.txt =====
// ---------- JSON for index.html ----------
// posts.php        -> { posts, paging, sample, theme }  (theme = how to lay out a card)
// posts.php?css=1  -> the theme CSS (and custom.css), with its Google Font

$theme = sw_theme();
if (isset($_GET['css'])) {
    header('Content-Type: text/css; charset=utf-8');
    $font = $theme['meta']['font_url'] ?? '';
    echo ($font ? '@import url("' . $font . "\");\n" : '') . $theme['css'];
    exit;
}
try {
    $data = sw_get_posts($theme);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[social-widget] ' . $e->getMessage());
    $data = ['posts' => [], 'paging' => null];
}
header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
header('Cache-Control: no-store');
echo json_encode([
    'posts' => $data['posts'] ?? [],
    'paging' => $data['paging'] ?? null,
    'sample' => !empty($data['sample']),
    'theme' => $theme['meta'],
], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

===== FILE: posts.php =====
<?php
// GENERATED by tools/build-previews.py from templates/php/index.php - edit that file.
// Social Widget - Simple HTML starter: the one server file (PHP 8).
// index.html fetches this file; it calls Tagembed and returns JSON. The token stays
// on this server; the browser only ever receives HTML.
//
// Settings (.env or the host's environment): ACCESS_TOKEN, API_BASE_URL, WIDGET_THEME.
// Look: themes/<WIDGET_THEME>.css, plus custom.css (optional) for your own changes.

declare(strict_types=1);

const CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 300; // 5 minutes: about 288 API calls a day, whatever the traffic

// ---------- settings ----------

/** getenv() first (cPanel, Docker...), else a tiny .env reader - no Composer needed. */
function sw_env(string $key, string $default = ''): string
{
    $value = getenv($key);
    if ($value !== false && $value !== '') {
        return $value;
    }
    static $file = null;
    if ($file === null) {
        $file = [];
        $path = __DIR__ . '/.env';
        if (is_readable($path)) {
            foreach (file($path, FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES | FILE_SKIP_EMPTY_LINES) as $line) {
                $line = trim($line);
                if ($line === '' || $line[0] === '#' || !str_contains($line, '=')) {
                    continue;
                }
                [$k, $v] = array_map('trim', explode('=', $line, 2));
                $file[$k] = trim($v, "\"'");
            }
        }
    }
    return $file[$key] ?? $default;
}

// ---------- theme ----------

function sw_theme(): array
{
    $slug = strtolower(trim(sw_env('WIDGET_THEME', 'modern-card')));
    if (!preg_match('/^[a-z-]+$/', $slug) || !is_file(__DIR__ . "/themes/$slug.json")) {
        error_log("[social-widget] Unknown WIDGET_THEME \"$slug\" - using modern-card");
        $slug = 'modern-card';
    }
    $meta = json_decode((string) file_get_contents(__DIR__ . "/themes/$slug.json"), true);
    $css = (string) file_get_contents(__DIR__ . "/themes/$slug.css");
    if (is_file(__DIR__ . '/custom.css')) {
        $css .= "\n  /* custom.css */\n" . file_get_contents(__DIR__ . '/custom.css');
    }
    return ['meta' => $meta, 'css' => $css];
}

function sw_samples(array $theme): array
{
    $file = ($theme['meta']['type'] ?? '') === 'review' ? 'reviews.json' : 'social.json';
    return json_decode((string) file_get_contents(__DIR__ . "/samples/$file"), true) ?: [];
}

// ---------- API + cache ----------

function sw_fetch_posts(string $base, string $token): array
{
    $url = "$base/v3/posts?limit=24";
    $headers = ["Authorization: Bearer $token", 'Accept: application/json'];
    if (function_exists('curl_init')) {
        $ch = curl_init($url);
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => $headers, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 10]);
        $raw = curl_exec($ch);
        $code = (int) curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
        if ($raw === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Tagembed API request failed: ' . curl_error($ch));
        }
    } else {
        $ctx = stream_context_create(['http' => ['header' => implode("\r\n", $headers), 'timeout' => 10, 'ignore_errors' => true]]);
        $raw = @file_get_contents($url, false, $ctx);
        if ($raw === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Tagembed API request failed');
        }
        $code = preg_match('/\s(\d{3})/', $http_response_header[0] ?? '', $m) ? (int) $m[1] : 0;
    }
    $json = json_decode((string) $raw, true);
    // Check the HTTP status AND the envelope flag: status can be false on a 200.
    if ($code < 200 || $code >= 300 || !is_array($json) || ($json['status'] ?? true) === false) {
        $detail = $code === 422 ? json_encode($json['body']['fields'] ?? null) : ($json['message'] ?? 'unexpected response');
        throw new RuntimeException("Tagembed API $code: $detail");
    }
    $body = is_array($json['body'] ?? null) ? $json['body'] : [];
    return ['posts' => is_array($body['posts'] ?? null) ? $body['posts'] : [], 'paging' => $body['paging'] ?? null];
}

function sw_read_cache(string $file): ?array
{
    $c = is_readable($file) ? json_decode((string) @file_get_contents($file), true) : null;
    return is_array($c) && isset($c['data']) ? $c : null;
}

function sw_get_posts(array $theme): array
{
    $token = trim(sw_env('ACCESS_TOKEN'));
    // No token yet: show the sample posts, touch neither the API nor the cache.
    if ($token === '') {
        return ['posts' => sw_samples($theme), 'paging' => null, 'sample' => true];
    }
    $base = rtrim(trim(sw_env('API_BASE_URL', 'https://api.tagembed.com/api')), '/');
    $dir = __DIR__ . '/cache';
    $file = "$dir/posts.json";

    $cached = sw_read_cache($file);
    if ($cached && time() - (int) $cached['saved_at'] < CACHE_TTL_SECONDS) {
        return $cached['data'];
    }

    // One refresh at a time: whoever gets the lock refreshes, the rest serve the old copy.
    if (!is_dir($dir)) {
        @mkdir($dir, 0775, true);
    }
    $lock = @fopen("$dir/posts.lock", 'c');
    if ($lock && !flock($lock, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)) {
        if ($cached) {
            fclose($lock);
            return $cached['data'];
        }
        flock($lock, LOCK_EX); // nothing to serve yet - wait for the other refresh
        $fresh = sw_read_cache($file);
        if ($fresh && time() - (int) $fresh['saved_at'] < CACHE_TTL_SECONDS) {
            fclose($lock);
            return $fresh['data'];
        }
    }

    try {
        $data = sw_fetch_posts($base, $token);
        // Write a temp file and rename it in, so a reader never sees half a file.
        $tmp = "$file." . getmypid() . '.tmp';
        if (@file_put_contents($tmp, json_encode(['saved_at' => time(), 'data' => $data])) === false || !@rename($tmp, $file)) {
            @unlink($tmp);
            error_log('[social-widget] Cache folder not writable, serving live');
        }
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        error_log('[social-widget] ' . $e->getMessage());
        // A failed refresh keeps serving the old copy; empty only if nothing ever loaded.
        $data = $cached ? $cached['data'] : ['posts' => [], 'paging' => null];
    }
    if ($lock) {
        fclose($lock);
    }
    return $data;
}

// ---------- JSON for index.html ----------
// posts.php        -> { posts, paging, sample, theme }  (theme = how to lay out a card)
// posts.php?css=1  -> the theme CSS (and custom.css), with its Google Font

$theme = sw_theme();
if (isset($_GET['css'])) {
    header('Content-Type: text/css; charset=utf-8');
    $font = $theme['meta']['font_url'] ?? '';
    echo ($font ? '@import url("' . $font . "\");\n" : '') . $theme['css'];
    exit;
}
try {
    $data = sw_get_posts($theme);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
    error_log('[social-widget] ' . $e->getMessage());
    $data = ['posts' => [], 'paging' => null];
}
header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
header('Cache-Control: no-store');
echo json_encode([
    'posts' => $data['posts'] ?? [],
    'paging' => $data['paging'] ?? null,
    'sample' => !empty($data['sample']),
    'theme' => $theme['meta'],
], JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);

===== FILE: themes/classic-card.css =====
  /* Classic Card theme - values from themes-lite.json. Change the look here. */
  :root {
    --tbd-bg: #E9EAF0;
    --tbd-surface: #ffffff;
    --tbd-text: #000000;
    --tbd-author: #000000;
    --tbd-font: "Open Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    --tbd-weight: 400;
    --tbd-size: 14px;
    --tbd-radius: 8px;
    --tbd-img-radius: 0px;
    --tbd-gap: 10px;
    --tbd-pad: 14px;
    --tbd-cols: 3;
    --tbd-align: left;
    --tbd-lines: 4;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--tbd-bg); color: var(--tbd-text);
    font-family: var(--tbd-font); font-weight: var(--tbd-weight); font-size: var(--tbd-size); }
  .tbd-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 32px 16px; }
  .tbd-header { margin: 0 0 24px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.9em; font-weight: 700; }
  /* Card: one markup for every theme; the theme block below orders and hides parts */
  .tbd-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--tbd-surface); color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none; border-radius: var(--tbd-radius); overflow: hidden; text-align: var(--tbd-align); }
  /* --tbd-ph: the sample file's tiny base64 thumbnail (preview only; live posts have none) */
  .tbd-media { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--tbd-img-radius);
    aspect-ratio: var(--tbd-ar, auto);
    background: var(--tbd-ph, none) center / cover no-repeat, linear-gradient(135deg, #e6e8f2, #f3e6ee); }
  /* Fallback tile: chat preview panes block outside images, so show the network name */
  .tbd-media::after { content: attr(data-network); position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid;
    place-items: center; font-size: .85em; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: .45; }
  .tbd-media img { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
  /* Blocked image: cover the broken-image icon with the thumbnail, if any */
  .tbd-media img::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background: var(--tbd-ph, none) center / cover no-repeat; }
  .tbd-play { position: absolute; z-index: 2; right: 10px; top: 10px; width: 28px; height: 28px;
    border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); }
  .tbd-play::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 8px;
    border-left: 9px solid #fff; border-top: 6px solid transparent; border-bottom: 6px solid transparent; }
  .tbd-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: var(--tbd-pad); }
  .tbd-avatar { flex: none; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover;
    background: #d9dbe3; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 700; color: #555; }
  /* Blocked avatar: show the author's initial instead of a broken-image icon */

  /* Classic Photo theme - values from themes-lite.json. Change the look here. */
  :root {
    --tbd-bg: #E9EAF0;
    --tbd-surface: #ffffff;
    --tbd-text: #000000;
    --tbd-author: #000000;
    --tbd-font: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    --tbd-weight: 400;
    --tbd-size: 14px;
    --tbd-radius: 8px;
    --tbd-img-radius: 8px;
    --tbd-gap: 12px;
    --tbd-pad: 16px;
    --tbd-cols: 3;
    --tbd-align: left;
    --tbd-lines: none;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--tbd-bg); color: var(--tbd-text);
    font-family: var(--tbd-font); font-weight: var(--tbd-weight); font-size: var(--tbd-size); }
  .tbd-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 32px 16px; }
  .tbd-header { margin: 0 0 24px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.9em; font-weight: 700; }
  /* Card: one markup for every theme; the theme block below orders and hides parts */
  .tbd-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--tbd-surface); color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none; border-radius: var(--tbd-radius); overflow: hidden; text-align: var(--tbd-align); }
  /* --tbd-ph: the sample file's tiny base64 thumbnail (preview only; live posts have none) */
  .tbd-media { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--tbd-img-radius);
    aspect-ratio: var(--tbd-ar, auto);
    background: var(--tbd-ph, none) center / cover no-repeat, linear-gradient(135deg, #e6e8f2, #f3e6ee); }
  /* Fallback tile: chat preview panes block outside images, so show the network name */
  .tbd-media::after { content: attr(data-network); position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid;
    place-items: center; font-size: .85em; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: .45; }
  .tbd-media img { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
  /* Blocked image: cover the broken-image icon with the thumbnail, if any */
  .tbd-media img::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background: var(--tbd-ph, none) center / cover no-repeat; }
  .tbd-play { position: absolute; z-index: 2; right: 10px; top: 10px; width: 28px; height: 28px;

    background: #d9dbe3; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 700; color: #555; }

  img.tbd-avatar { position: relative; }

    place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #d9dbe3; }

  .tbd-arrow--prev { left: -10px; }

  .tbd-card { box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.08); text-align: center; }

  .tbd-head { flex-direction: column; margin-top: -28px; position: relative; z-index: 2; gap: 6px; }

===== FILE: themes/horizontal-slider.css =====
  /* Horizontal Slider theme - values from themes-lite.json. Change the look here. */
  :root {
    --tbd-bg: #E9EAF0;
    --tbd-surface: #ffffff;
    --tbd-text: #000000;
    --tbd-author: #000000;
    --tbd-font: "Open Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    --tbd-weight: 400;
    --tbd-size: 14px;
    --tbd-radius: 8px;
    --tbd-img-radius: 8px;
    --tbd-gap: 10px;
    --tbd-pad: 14px;
    --tbd-cols: 3;
    --tbd-align: left;
    --tbd-lines: 3;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--tbd-bg); color: var(--tbd-text);
    font-family: var(--tbd-font); font-weight: var(--tbd-weight); font-size: var(--tbd-size); }
  .tbd-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 32px 16px; }
  .tbd-header { margin: 0 0 24px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.9em; font-weight: 700; }
  /* Card: one markup for every theme; the theme block below orders and hides parts */
  .tbd-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--tbd-surface); color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none; border-radius: var(--tbd-radius); overflow: hidden; text-align: var(--tbd-align); }
  /* --tbd-ph: the sample file's tiny base64 thumbnail (preview only; live posts have none) */
  .tbd-media { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--tbd-img-radius);
    aspect-ratio: var(--tbd-ar, auto);
    background: var(--tbd-ph, none) center / cover no-repeat, linear-gradient(135deg, #e6e8f2, #f3e6ee); }
  /* Fallback tile: chat preview panes block outside images, so show the network name */
  .tbd-media::after { content: attr(data-network); position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid;
    place-items: center; font-size: .85em; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: .45; }
  .tbd-media img { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
  /* Blocked image: cover the broken-image icon with the thumbnail, if any */
  .tbd-media img::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background: var(--tbd-ph, none) center / cover no-repeat; }
  .tbd-play { position: absolute; z-index: 2; right: 10px; top: 10px; width: 28px; height: 28px;
    border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); }
  .tbd-play::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 8px;
    border-left: 9px solid #fff; border-top: 6px solid transparent; border-bottom: 6px solid transparent; }
  .tbd-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: var(--tbd-pad); }
  .tbd-avatar { flex: none; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover;
    background: #d9dbe3; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 700; color: #555; }
  /* Blocked avatar: show the author's initial instead of a broken-image icon */
  img.tbd-avatar { position: relative; }
  img.tbd-avatar::before { content: attr(data-initial); position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid;
    place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #d9dbe3; }
  .tbd-who { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; text-align: left; }
  .tbd-author { color: var(--tbd-author); font-weight: 600; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  .tbd-date { font-size: .8em; opacity: .6; }
  .tbd-net { flex: none; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center;
    background: #888; color: #fff; font: 700 11px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; }
  .tbd-net::before { content: attr(data-mark); }
  .tbd-net[data-net="instagram"] { background: linear-gradient(45deg, #f9ce34, #ee2a7b 55%, #6228d7); }
  .tbd-net[data-net="facebook"] { background: #1877f2; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="twitter"], .tbd-net[data-net="x"], .tbd-net[data-net="tiktok"] { background: #111; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="youtube"] { background: #ff0000; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="linkedin"] { background: #0a66c2; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="pinterest"] { background: #e60023; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="google"] { background: #4285f4; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="yelp"] { background: #d32323; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="tripadvisor"] { background: #34e0a1; color: #000; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="trustpilot"] { background: #00b67a; }
  .tbd-stars { padding: var(--tbd-pad) var(--tbd-pad) 0; text-align: center; color: #f5b50a; letter-spacing: 2px; }
  .tbd-text { margin: 0; padding: 0 var(--tbd-pad) var(--tbd-pad); line-height: 1.5; }
  .tbd-card > :first-child.tbd-text { padding-top: var(--tbd-pad); }
  .tbd-clamp .tbd-text { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    -webkit-line-clamp: var(--tbd-lines); line-clamp: var(--tbd-lines); overflow: hidden; }
  /* Starters only: no posts yet, and the "sample posts" note */
  .tbd-empty, .tbd-note { text-align: center; opacity: .7; margin: 0 0 16px; }

  /* Slider: one row that scrolls sideways; the arrows scroll one view */
  .tbd-slider { position: relative; }
  .tbd-track { display: flex; gap: var(--tbd-gap); overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scrollbar-width: none; padding: 4px 2px 12px; }
  .tbd-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .tbd-card { flex: 0 0 calc((100% - (var(--tbd-cols) - 1) * var(--tbd-gap)) / var(--tbd-cols));
    scroll-snap-align: start; }
  @media (max-width: 900px) { .tbd-card { flex-basis: calc((100% - var(--tbd-gap)) / 2); } }
  @media (max-width: 560px) { .tbd-card { flex-basis: 85%; } }
  .tbd-arrow { position: absolute; z-index: 4; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 36px; height: 36px;
    border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; color: #333; font-size: 20px; cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2); }
  .tbd-arrow--prev { left: -10px; }
  .tbd-arrow--next { right: -10px; }

  .tbd-card { border-radius: 0; background: none; }
  .tbd-media { aspect-ratio: 7 / 6; }
  .tbd-arrow { border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.75); color: #fff; }
  .tbd-arrow--prev { left: 8px; } .tbd-arrow--next { right: 8px; }

  /* Blocked image: cover the broken-image icon with the thumbnail, if any */
  .tbd-media img::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background: var(--tbd-ph, none) center / cover no-repeat; }
  .tbd-play { position: absolute; z-index: 2; right: 10px; top: 10px; width: 28px; height: 28px;
    border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); }
  .tbd-play::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 8px;
    border-left: 9px solid #fff; border-top: 6px solid transparent; border-bottom: 6px solid transparent; }
  .tbd-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: var(--tbd-pad); }
  .tbd-avatar { flex: none; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover;
    background: #d9dbe3; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 700; color: #555; }
  /* Blocked avatar: show the author's initial instead of a broken-image icon */
  img.tbd-avatar { position: relative; }
  img.tbd-avatar::before { content: attr(data-initial); position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid;
    place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #d9dbe3; }
  .tbd-who { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; text-align: left; }
  .tbd-author { color: var(--tbd-author); font-weight: 600; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  .tbd-date { font-size: .8em; opacity: .6; }
  .tbd-net { flex: none; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center;
    background: #888; color: #fff; font: 700 11px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; }
  .tbd-net::before { content: attr(data-mark); }
  .tbd-net[data-net="instagram"] { background: linear-gradient(45deg, #f9ce34, #ee2a7b 55%, #6228d7); }
  .tbd-net[data-net="facebook"] { background: #1877f2; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="twitter"], .tbd-net[data-net="x"], .tbd-net[data-net="tiktok"] { background: #111; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="youtube"] { background: #ff0000; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="linkedin"] { background: #0a66c2; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="pinterest"] { background: #e60023; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="google"] { background: #4285f4; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="yelp"] { background: #d32323; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="tripadvisor"] { background: #34e0a1; color: #000; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="trustpilot"] { background: #00b67a; }
  .tbd-stars { padding: var(--tbd-pad) var(--tbd-pad) 0; text-align: center; color: #f5b50a; letter-spacing: 2px; }
  .tbd-text { margin: 0; padding: 0 var(--tbd-pad) var(--tbd-pad); line-height: 1.5; }
  .tbd-card > :first-child.tbd-text { padding-top: var(--tbd-pad); }
  .tbd-clamp .tbd-text { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    -webkit-line-clamp: var(--tbd-lines); line-clamp: var(--tbd-lines); overflow: hidden; }
  /* Starters only: no posts yet, and the "sample posts" note */
  .tbd-empty, .tbd-note { text-align: center; opacity: .7; margin: 0 0 16px; }

  /* Grid: --tbd-cols columns, 2 on tablet, 1 on phone */
  .tbd-track { display: grid; gap: var(--tbd-gap); align-items: start;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--tbd-cols), minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  @media (max-width: 900px) { .tbd-track { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
  @media (max-width: 560px) { .tbd-track { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  .tbd-track { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .tbd-card { box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.07); }
  .tbd-stars { padding-top: 16px; }
  .tbd-text { padding-top: 10px; }

  /* Review Carousel theme - values from themes-lite.json. Change the look here. */
  :root {
    --tbd-bg: #F0F7FF;
    --tbd-surface: #FFFFFF;
    --tbd-text: #000000;
    --tbd-author: #000000;
    --tbd-font: "Open Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    --tbd-weight: 400;
    --tbd-size: 14px;
    --tbd-radius: 8px;
    --tbd-img-radius: 8px;
    --tbd-gap: 12px;
    --tbd-pad: 16px;
    --tbd-cols: 3;
    --tbd-align: left;
    --tbd-lines: 6;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--tbd-bg); color: var(--tbd-text);
    font-family: var(--tbd-font); font-weight: var(--tbd-weight); font-size: var(--tbd-size); }
  .tbd-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 32px 16px; }
  .tbd-header { margin: 0 0 24px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.9em; font-weight: 700; }
  /* Card: one markup for every theme; the theme block below orders and hides parts */
  .tbd-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--tbd-surface); color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none; border-radius: var(--tbd-radius); overflow: hidden; text-align: var(--tbd-align); }
  /* --tbd-ph: the sample file's tiny base64 thumbnail (preview only; live posts have none) */
  .tbd-media { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--tbd-img-radius);
    aspect-ratio: var(--tbd-ar, auto);
    background: var(--tbd-ph, none) center / cover no-repeat, linear-gradient(135deg, #e6e8f2, #f3e6ee); }
  /* Fallback tile: chat preview panes block outside images, so show the network name */
  .tbd-media::after { content: attr(data-network); position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid;
    place-items: center; font-size: .85em; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: .45; }

  @media (max-width: 900px) { .tbd-card { flex-basis: calc((100% - var(--tbd-gap)) / 2); } }
  @media (max-width: 560px) { .tbd-card { flex-basis: 85%; } }
  .tbd-arrow { position: absolute; z-index: 4; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 36px; height: 36px;
    border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; color: #333; font-size: 20px; cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2); }
  .tbd-arrow--prev { left: -10px; }
  .tbd-arrow--next { right: -10px; }

  .tbd-slider { max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .tbd-card { flex-basis: 100%; border-radius: 0; background: none; }
  .tbd-media { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1.07; }
  .tbd-arrow { width: 48px; height: 48px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.85); }
  .tbd-arrow--prev { left: 12px; } .tbd-arrow--next { right: 12px; }
  @media (max-width: 900px) { .tbd-card { flex-basis: 100%; } }

===== FILE: themes/slider.css =====
  /* Slider theme - values from themes-lite.json. Change the look here. */
  :root {
    --tbd-bg: #ffffff;
    --tbd-surface: #fafafa;
    --tbd-text: #1f1f1f;
    --tbd-author: #000000;
    --tbd-font: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    --tbd-weight: 400;
    --tbd-size: 14px;
    --tbd-radius: 3px;
    --tbd-img-radius: 8px;
    --tbd-gap: 10px;
    --tbd-pad: 12px;
    --tbd-cols: 4;
    --tbd-align: left;
    --tbd-lines: none;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--tbd-bg); color: var(--tbd-text);
    font-family: var(--tbd-font); font-weight: var(--tbd-weight); font-size: var(--tbd-size); }
  .tbd-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 32px 16px; }
  .tbd-header { margin: 0 0 24px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.9em; font-weight: 700; }
  /* Card: one markup for every theme; the theme block below orders and hides parts */
  .tbd-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--tbd-surface); color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none; border-radius: var(--tbd-radius); overflow: hidden; text-align: var(--tbd-align); }
  /* --tbd-ph: the sample file's tiny base64 thumbnail (preview only; live posts have none) */
  .tbd-media { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--tbd-img-radius);
    aspect-ratio: var(--tbd-ar, auto);
    background: var(--tbd-ph, none) center / cover no-repeat, linear-gradient(135deg, #e6e8f2, #f3e6ee); }
  /* Fallback tile: chat preview panes block outside images, so show the network name */
  .tbd-media::after { content: attr(data-network); position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid;
    place-items: center; font-size: .85em; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: .45; }
  .tbd-media img { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
  /* Blocked image: cover the broken-image icon with the thumbnail, if any */
  .tbd-media img::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background: var(--tbd-ph, none) center / cover no-repeat; }
  .tbd-play { position: absolute; z-index: 2; right: 10px; top: 10px; width: 28px; height: 28px;
    border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); }
  .tbd-play::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 8px;
    border-left: 9px solid #fff; border-top: 6px solid transparent; border-bottom: 6px solid transparent; }
  .tbd-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: var(--tbd-pad); }
  .tbd-avatar { flex: none; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover;
    background: #d9dbe3; display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 700; color: #555; }
  /* Blocked avatar: show the author's initial instead of a broken-image icon */
  img.tbd-avatar { position: relative; }
  img.tbd-avatar::before { content: attr(data-initial); position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid;
    place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: #d9dbe3; }
  .tbd-who { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; text-align: left; }
  .tbd-author { color: var(--tbd-author); font-weight: 600; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  .tbd-date { font-size: .8em; opacity: .6; }
  .tbd-net { flex: none; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center;
    background: #888; color: #fff; font: 700 11px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; }
  .tbd-net::before { content: attr(data-mark); }
  .tbd-net[data-net="instagram"] { background: linear-gradient(45deg, #f9ce34, #ee2a7b 55%, #6228d7); }
  .tbd-net[data-net="facebook"] { background: #1877f2; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="twitter"], .tbd-net[data-net="x"], .tbd-net[data-net="tiktok"] { background: #111; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="youtube"] { background: #ff0000; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="linkedin"] { background: #0a66c2; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="pinterest"] { background: #e60023; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="google"] { background: #4285f4; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="yelp"] { background: #d32323; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="tripadvisor"] { background: #34e0a1; color: #000; }
  .tbd-net[data-net="trustpilot"] { background: #00b67a; }
  .tbd-stars { padding: var(--tbd-pad) var(--tbd-pad) 0; text-align: center; color: #f5b50a; letter-spacing: 2px; }
  .tbd-text { margin: 0; padding: 0 var(--tbd-pad) var(--tbd-pad); line-height: 1.5; }
  .tbd-card > :first-child.tbd-text { padding-top: var(--tbd-pad); }
  .tbd-clamp .tbd-text { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    -webkit-line-clamp: var(--tbd-lines); line-clamp: var(--tbd-lines); overflow: hidden; }
  /* Starters only: no posts yet, and the "sample posts" note */
  .tbd-empty, .tbd-note { text-align: center; opacity: .7; margin: 0 0 16px; }

  /* Slider: one row that scrolls sideways; the arrows scroll one view */
  .tbd-slider { position: relative; }
  .tbd-track { display: flex; gap: var(--tbd-gap); overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    scrollbar-width: none; padding: 4px 2px 12px; }
  .tbd-track::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .tbd-card { flex: 0 0 calc((100% - (var(--tbd-cols) - 1) * var(--tbd-gap)) / var(--tbd-cols));
    scroll-snap-align: start; }
  @media (max-width: 900px) { .tbd-card { flex-basis: calc((100% - var(--tbd-gap)) / 2); } }
  @media (max-width: 560px) { .tbd-card { flex-basis: 85%; } }
  .tbd-arrow { position: absolute; z-index: 4; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 36px; height: 36px;
    border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; color: #333; font-size: 20px; cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.2); }
  .tbd-arrow--prev { left: -10px; }
  .tbd-arrow--next { right: -10px; }

  .tbd-card { background: none; }
  .tbd-media { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; }
  /* Hover: darken the photo and show the network name */
  .tbd-media::before { content: attr(data-network); position: absolute; z-index: 2; inset: 0; display: grid;
    place-items: center; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; background: rgba(0,0,0,.4); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .2s; }
  .tbd-card:hover .tbd-media::before, .tbd-card:focus-visible .tbd-media::before { opacity: 1; }

  /* Vivid theme - values from themes-lite.json. Change the look here. */
  :root {
    --tbd-bg: #ffffff;
    --tbd-surface: #fafafa;
    --tbd-text: #1f1b1b;
    --tbd-author: #1f1b1b;
    --tbd-font: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    --tbd-weight: 400;
    --tbd-size: 14px;
    --tbd-radius: 3px;
    --tbd-img-radius: 0px;
    --tbd-gap: 10px;
    --tbd-pad: 14px;
    --tbd-cols: 4;
    --tbd-align: left;
    --tbd-lines: 4;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  body { margin: 0; background: var(--tbd-bg); color: var(--tbd-text);
    font-family: var(--tbd-font); font-weight: var(--tbd-weight); font-size: var(--tbd-size); }
  .tbd-widget { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 32px 16px; }
  .tbd-header { margin: 0 0 24px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.9em; font-weight: 700; }
  /* Card: one markup for every theme; the theme block below orders and hides parts */
  .tbd-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--tbd-surface); color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none; border-radius: var(--tbd-radius); overflow: hidden; text-align: var(--tbd-align); }
  /* --tbd-ph: the sample file's tiny base64 thumbnail (preview only; live posts have none) */
  .tbd-media { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: var(--tbd-img-radius);
    aspect-ratio: var(--tbd-ar, auto);
    background: var(--tbd-ph, none) center / cover no-repeat, linear-gradient(135deg, #e6e8f2, #f3e6ee); }
  /* Fallback tile: chat preview panes block outside images, so show the network name */

    place-items: center; font-size: .85em; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: .45; }
